custom_geometry.code: const group = new THREE.Group(); const steps = 5; const stepWidth = 3; const stepHeight = height / steps; for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) { const currentW = width - i * stepWidth * 2; const currentD = depth - i * stepWidth * 2; const currentH = height - i * stepHeight; if (i === steps - 1) { const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(currentW, currentH, currentD); const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo); mesh.position.y = -height / 2 + currentH / 2; group.add(mesh); } else { const shape = new THREE.Shape(); shape.moveTo(-currentW/2, -currentD/2); shape.lineTo(currentW/2, -currentD/2); shape.lineTo(currentW/2, currentD/2); shape.lineTo(-currentW/2, currentD/2); shape.lineTo(-currentW/2, -currentD/2); const holeW = currentW - stepWidth * 2; const holeD = currentD - stepWidth * 2; const hole = new THREE.Path(); hole.moveTo(-holeW/2, -holeD/2); hole.lineTo(-holeW/2, holeD/2); hole.lineTo(holeW/2, holeD/2); hole.lineTo(holeW/2, -holeD/2); hole.lineTo(-holeW/2, -holeD/2); shape.holes.push(hole); const extrudeSettings = { depth: currentH, bevelEnabled: false }; const geo = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape, extrudeSettings); geo.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); geo.translate(0, -height / 2, 0); const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo); group.add(mesh); } } return group;
